name: Flank Steak with Italian-Style Spicy Fennel, Orange & Olive Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Mince anchovy fillets. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.

Place steak on a plate, season with salt and pepper on both sides, then drizzle with half of the dressing. Turn to coat and set aside to marinate, 15 minutes. (Reserve remaining dressing for the next step.)
While the steak is marinating, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
Halve olives lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Cut off skin and white pith from oranges; slice between the membranes to release segments. Add to the bowl and set aside.
When the steak is done marinating, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the olives and orange segments.
Pick parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems. Add leaves to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
